oneLiner: A dashboard that helps PMs re-orient when switching between projects, showing the last decision made, blockers, and who's waiting on what.
problem: Product managers juggle multiple projects simultaneously, losing critical context when switching between them. This context loss leads to duplicated work, missed blockers, delayed decisions, and team frustration from unclear ownership and status.
targetUser: Product managers who own 2+ concurrent projects and need to stay aligned with their teams
coreFlow: User logs in and views all their projects in a prioritized list
User selects a project to view its re-orientation dashboard
Dashboard displays the most recent decision, current blockers, and pending dependencies
User sees who is waiting on their input and what action items need attention
User can quick-add updates or mark blockers as resolved to keep context fresh

screens.name: Project Roster
screens.purpose: Shows all projects the PM owns with last activity timestamp and unresolved blocker count to guide which project needs attention first

screens.name: Re-orientation Dashboard
screens.purpose: Displays the last decision made, active blockers with owners, dependencies waiting on this PM, and team members waiting for input

screens.name: Decision Timeline
screens.purpose: Chronological view of recent project decisions with context and participants to quickly recall what was decided and why

screens.name: Blocker Detail
screens.purpose: Deep view of a single blocker showing who owns it, impact on timeline, and conversation history for fast resolution

outOfScope: Project planning or roadmap management tools
Team communication or messaging (integrates with existing tools instead)
